title: Just ok.
text:
Just ok.. There dII curtains are not modern looking , and the color is like a flat darkish gray!
There not lacy if that is what your looking for, and not as flowy as what I thought they would be.

After I washed these curtains, and put them in the dryer on low with a dryer sheet, and wool balls, they got softer, and for some reason look a better.
I’m putting them behind another type of drapes to use these like a shire, and just the edge with show.

description: Add A Finishing Touch To Any Room

Give your home decor style, elegance and sophistication, when you decorate with sheer window panels. These curtains were designed in several different patterns to ensure you find the perfect one for your space. Not intended to block light, these lace curtains allow sunlight to filter in naturally creating a light and airy setting. Lace curtains aren’t just for your grandma but can add texture, interest, and romanticize a place. Layer over an existing, solid window treatment with these to add interest or frame your window with flowing, delicate drapes that brighten your home.

Rod pockets make for easy installation, choose one you love, slide the curtain panels on, hang, and enjoy! Our lace window curtains are all wrinkle resistant to keep your home looking beautifully neat and tidy.

These lace curtains can add immediate elegance to any room on a budget. Decorate your living space, dinning room, sitting room, bedroom, or dorm. Curtains are 100% Polyester, woven into a design top and bottom hems.
There Is A Perfect Size For Your Window

Multiple size windows in your home? We offer multiple sized curtain panels in a set of 2, so you are sure to find the perfect set for your needs. Combine 2 sets in case your windows are extra wide! Our curtains are available in these sizes: 50x63”, 50x84”, 50x96”, and 50x108”.
We also have a helpful size guide in the image section to help you determine which size is right for you.
Want to see more? To view our entire selection of Curtains search: DII Curtains or visit our store front to explore our other collections by clicking the DII link at the top of this page.
